scope: Native equivalents of conditional supporting declarations used by stable contracts; not blanket stabilization of experimental APIs

families.native: Allocator identity and allocation/deallocation/clone capabilities; default Global remains usable without selecting a nightly parameter. Explicit native custom allocation is separately accepted.
Preserve the frozen eligible sequence/index shapes and associated outputs. Checked disjoint access rejects overlap before producing exclusive views.
Native sealed text-pattern/search capabilities preserve valid UTF-8 boundaries and forward/reverse/double-ended eligibility independently.
Compiler/library initialization-clone capability tracks the initialized extent and cleans partial results on panic; no reference to uninitialized T is formed.
Compiler-known primitive eligibility for unchecked conversions, formatting buffers and zero-valid values. Preserve each operation's exact unsafe range/validity preconditions.
Sealed range/stepping protocols preserve the frozen valid scalar and one-sided range shapes, overflow and end-point contracts.
Compiler-derived discriminant, callable-pointer, metadata-size, pointee and tuple eligibility; aliases do not change eligibility and users cannot forge property implementations.
Read/mutate/consume async callable capabilities preserve capture regions and concrete future identity; unstable explicit call methods/associated families remain excluded.
Sealed short-circuit/output/residual protocol for the frozen eligible optional/outcome/control-flow/poll shapes; preserve residual identity without implicit error conversion.
Native Never has no values; divergent coercion does not make an invalid constructed value valid.
Stable scalar atomic aliases preserve their exact payload and target-supported lock-free operations without promising arbitrary generic Atomic instantiations.
Compiler-known variadic cursor eligibility preserves supported promoted scalar/pointer types and the selected C ABI. Reading the wrong actual argument type remains unsafe.
The selected target's OS error representation preserves lossless raw-error round trips; the unstable alias spelling does not remove stable constructors/accessors.
